classes: C1 — complete (non-shallow) repository, path with history: the date of the newest commit that TOUCHED the path (2026-09-16 / 7a94ab04 for dataset/.skills at this head). Correct today.

C2 — SHALLOW repository (git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository = true): the grafted tip has no parents, so git reports it as ADDING every file and `git log -1 -- <path>` returns the TIP commit date whatever it touched. The function cannot know the path's real date; the only honest answer is null. THE DEFECT.
C3 — complete repository, path no commit ever touched: `git log` prints nothing, the regex rejects it, null. Correct today.
C4 — not a git repository / git absent: execFileSync throws, null. Correct today.

I2 — C1 x C2 on ONE tree: the same commit read from a complete and from a shallow checkout must not produce a staleness failure in one and silence in the other. I3 — C6 x the DERIVATION: the defect is only observable where the gate RUNS, and 'where it runs' is computed from two authorities at once — the workflow documents (all of them, not a chosen file) and the root script closure (so an indirect spelling counts). This is a NAMED, ACCEPTED outcome of this group's fix, discharged by obligation r2-g1-rem1 in the same round (group r2-g3).
